name: pouchwale-priority-configurator
description: Rank product priorities and get star-rated pouch recommendations (PouchWale).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n db,api,web -c yellow,blue,magenta "npm run db -w server" "npm run dev:wait -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
